scope: Freeze the exact static radial MD-2S background model before implementing a replacement boundary-value solver.
separation_rules: The COS-01.1 homogeneous cosmological minisuperspace system with a(t) and b(t) is not the MD-2S static radial cap boundary-value problem.
The global A0 benchmark values are reproduction targets, not sufficient equations or boundary data.
The later SCI-001/SCI-002 parent-action skeleton constrains the rebuild but does not by itself specify the historical A0 solver normalization.
No parameter may be chosen solely to reproduce one benchmark unless it is declared as a fitted or shooting parameter before execution.

frozen_or_high_confidence_inputs.metric_ansatz: ds6^2 = exp(2A(r)) gbar_munu dx^mu dx^nu + dr^2 + L(r)^2 dchi^2

coordinate_roles.r: radial internal coordinate with length dimension
coordinate_roles.chi: dimensionless angular coordinate with explicit period still to be frozen
coordinate_roles.L: internal circumference radius with length dimension

frozen_or_high_confidence_inputs.latest_archived_result: MD-2S-B1.4N reports no global solution with fixed smooth centre and only the minimal cap controls; the unrestricted algebraic solution uses a conical centre mode.
frozen_or_high_confidence_inputs.next_audit: MD-2S-B1.4O additional geometric control rank audit

required: dimensions and normalization of every term
series coefficients through the order needed to initialize the solver
regularity of curvature and flux invariants
identification of the forbidden conical rescue mode
declared tolerances for every reproduction target

source_priority: canonical SCI-001/SCI-002 parent-action files for current variational conventions
historical MD-2S derivation text for reconstruction targets
reported benchmark tables for numerical regression only
chat prose as provenance, never as sole release authority

entry_gate.condition: MF-001 through MF-007 must each have a versioned source-backed specification and no unresolved sign or normalization collision.
entry_gate.exception: A symbolic sandbox may be used to compare candidate conventions, but its output must be labeled diagnostic and cannot populate the official benchmark or junction files.

r1_subphases.title: Independent numerical BVP implementations
r1_subphases.requirement: At least two numerically distinct implementations or one implementation plus an independent residual evaluator.

r1_subphases.title: A0 benchmark reproduction and convergence study
